note: India data-channel registry (Order L41). Tier A = official/open API or open dataset; B = polite reading of public pages (1 req/s, robots honoured); C = automated access forbidden by robots/terms OR robots/terms could not be fetched (conservative default). Tier C stays off unless env LEADSCOUT_INDIA_TIER_C=1. Every channel matches a section in docs/leadgen/INDIA_CHANNELS.md (research date 2026-10-07). Categories is the channel's strongest-fit order (that order is the ranking used by channelsFor()).
